_comment: Keeper L1-vs-L2 divergence alert (Grafana unified alerting).
Fires when keeper_route_divergent == 1 on any route: L1 curl failed while
L2 opencode CLI passed on the same route+run (the 'weird' case).
Plain down (both legs fail) does NOT page here by design.
APPLIED LIVE 2026-09-18 via provisioning API (folder keeper, group
grafanacloud-prom (Hosted Prometheus fed by keeper-alloy; Cloud cannot
HonzaTraderBot (telegram, owner-confirmed). This file mirrors the
applied rule field-for-field (condition C, A range -> B reduce(last)
-> C threshold gt 0); notification_settings is the unified-alerting
receiver binding (legacy file-provisioning `notifications` is NOT used).
Shape lessons: the reduce step is MANDATORY on this Cloud version
(unreduced time-series input is rejected: 'only reduced data can be
alerted on'); multi-series labels survive reduce (one instance per
route). Group interval is SECONDS (60), not '1m' (string 400s).
for 0s: pages immediately on a split (splits are rare + actionable).
Deleted same-day: stale twin rule cfyn4k7ofc16of (earlier 2-stage attempt,
no receiver, permanent eval error) + keeper-bisect scratch group.

rules.title: Keeper route divergent (curl fails, opencode CLI passes)

annotations.description: Direct HTTP probing failed but the opencode CLI leg passed on the same route+run. Credential or policy anomaly, not an outage. Matrix: https://keeper.pkubelka.cz/
